question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "disseminate" in the sentence given below:

He tried to conceal his excitement, but the sparkle in his eyes gave away the joy he felt at the surprise.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disseminate"** means to spread or disperse (something, especially information) widely. (फैलाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The organization aims to **disseminate **information about the benefits of a healthy lifestyle.
 
 
 
• **"Conceal" **means to keep from sight; hide. (छिपाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She tried to **conceal **her true feelings about the situation.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'disseminate' **is **'conceal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sparkle **(चमक): Shine brightly with flashes of light.

 
 
• **Example:** Her eyes** sparkle** with excitement whenever she talks about her favorite subject.
 
 
 
• **Gave **(दिया): Past tense of give; to present voluntarily and without expecting compensation.
 
 
• **Example: **He **gave** her a gift on her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Felt** (महसूस किया): Past tense of feel; to be aware of a physical or emotional sensation.
 
 
• **Example:** She **felt **a sense of relief after hearing the good news.
